title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 2.69 (versions follow prime numbers; 269 after 263): her tastes, learned from him, and her thoughts at their side. Each book of hers has her wish, (S + 1/2)/(N + 1), kept in 'gustos': N when she answers with a line of it, S when he follows the talk after (a word of that exchange again in his). A line weighs the words of his it has times her wish for its book; no number set by hand, every book starts at one half. Her last thought is no longer drawn under the talk: it stays in her flow, on the right. Measured in a copy: called 'Luma', she answered from her heart ('Mi papa, Nicolas') and not with a comment of her code. Stated: 'gustos' was not yet seen to grow (in test talks her answers came from her heart and from 'quien es', which does not use these tastes yet). Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v2.69: sus gustos los aprende de él, y sus pensamientos a su lado. Prototipo de investigación.
